thread:
ana-marketing: Heads-up team 1 NimbusHealth pilot wrapped last week. They agreed to a customer story if we can get legal signoff + a short interview. Can someone take interview lead? :spiral_calendar:
sam-legal: Well need written consent for any quotes, logo, and the webinar. Also confirm PR lead at NimbusHealth so we can sync on embargo windows.
tom-sales: PR lead is Mia at Nimbus. Pilot numbers they mentioned: 2.5x latency improvement and ~55% inference cost reduction vs their previous stack. Please don't put numbers live without confirmation.
jess-product: Can we capture the test matrix? sequence lengths, model family, quantization, and whether batch pre-warming was used. Otherwise the 55% number could be misleading.
oliver-cs: I can join the call to validate infra and clarify the caching/batching details.
pat-cs: I have the performance dashboard screenshots from the pilot. I can attach them to the intake doc.
nana-marketing: Draft quote attempt below 1 please edit: 

"Using Redwood Inference, we delivered faster responses and cut inference spend significantly, which unlocked new patient-facing features."  - Priya, NimbusHealth

lauren-legal: Make that 'reported' instead of absolute phrasing until we have the signed consent. Also request attribution style (name + title) from them. I'll circulate a short consent template that covers quote, logo, and screenshot usage.
zoe-growth: Webinar idea: "Delivering real-time LLM features in healthcare  NimbusHealth + Redwood"  co-present with their Head of Eng. We'll add a registration checkbox: "Interested in Dedicated/Private deployment" to route sales.
tom-sales: Please include an "Enterprise contact me" hidden field so we can capture ARR intent.
jess-product: Also recommend an appendix on the landing page listing test conditions so readers can interpret the benchmark numbers.
nana-marketing: Good call. I'll draft the landing page and include a benchmark methodology section and a short FAQ about data residency. Draft intake doc here: https://docs.redwood/inbox/nimbus-case (will update permissions).
sam-legal: Please add Nimbus PR and legal users to the doc with view/comment as appropriate. Lock the public link until consent is returned.
calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: NimbusHealth interview Tue 11:00-11:30am PT. Invitation sent to: ana-marketing, tom-sales, oliver-cs, priya-nimbus (guest), mia-nimbus (guest).
nana-marketing: After the interview I'll prepare two quote variants: one numbers-agnostic and one with precise metrics that we can use once they sign. Circulating both for legal sign-off.
lauren-legal: I'll review and send the consent doc. If they request edits, we'll iterate but try to keep the timeline (launch/webinar next month).
pat-cs: Uploaded dashboard screenshots to the intake doc.
jess-product: Thanks all. If we can confirm metrics on the call, we can lock the short-form case study + webinar slide deck within 2 business days.
nana-marketing: Perfect  I'll follow up post-interview with the quote options and the landing page draft. :rocket:
